notes.title: Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, bandits!

We've just uploaded a small patch with minor improvements:

- coursor in Drinking Game now flashes when hover it over a bottle
- quest related information hides after a while so it doesn't obstruct the view
- small stability improvements
- fixed some bugs during fist fights

We are currently working on performance and other fixes that we've noticed. Next updates coming next week.

Remember that this our first 3D game released on Steam and we are eager to hear from you about your experience with the game. Let us know through Discord.

Cheers!

PS. Here's some gameplay from the pre release version :D

notes.title: New name, new trailer, demo update
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Bandits,

As we are getting closer to releasing the game, we have a few announcements!

First of all, we are changing the name of the game. Bandit Brawler better reflects the game genre and vibe. Since we will be punching a lot of suckers in the face, it only made sense.

Bandit Simulator is dead. Long live Bandit Brawler.

Secondly, there is a large update coming for the demo tomorrow. The list of fixes includes:
- graphical fixes
- bleeding mechanic fix
- adjustments to UI
- bugs hunted
- changes in some NPC behavior
- better chest contents
- urinating on folks works better now
- adjustments to the quests UI

Also, we are very proud to introduce to you our launch trailer which you can watch on the game's Steam profile.

Enjoy! The game's coming very soon!

Titanite Games

notes.title: Bandit Simulator - Devlog #5
notes.content:
Hello, bandits!

Recently, we wrote mainly about the grounds and buildings. Of course, if you haven't seen it yet, we recommend you to see it.
 

However, today, we are going to tell you more about character production.
In the world of a bandit, you will meet many interesting characters, from simple bandits, through traders and villagers, to guards and knights.

                                                                                                                                    


           {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/01e283c3786a4e2f7ecc389b2bd093eb306d11c8.gif


We try to make each group unique and make sure what you can expect from it as soon as you see it.

With a few character groups, the game will also feature specific unique characters that are key to the story and will offer special items for your bandit. Of course, we won't reveal anything else here, so as not to spoil the surprise, but we can tell you in secret that not all characters will be normal.

Below we present one of the works of our graphic designers.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/3f6378e38be54a9685f66b14976eaaa281661907.png   


What other characters would you like to see in the bandit world and what should their special features be?  Write your answers and remember, hit add to wishlist button, to be up to date.


                                                                                                                                    

Best regards,
Bandit Simulator team

notes.title: Bandit Simulator - Devlog #4
notes.content:
Hello, bandits!

We recently wrote about the outside world, forts, and stuff. If you haven't seen it, it's worth catching up. 

However, today, we want to show you a piece of the city. That will be the main residence of the population in our game. 

                                                                                                                                    

          {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/080b813af9d8f404adf19db658535ff6239f2c6a.gif

In the city, you will be able to do a lot of things to feel like a real bandit. From robbing people and engaging in fights with guards, through hijacking or port robbery tasks, to indulging in tavern games and fights.

Below we present two pictures. The city is in the production process, so everything can still change.

          {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/9a2ba1f92c82e66b224182a39ac22f820bc26341.png

          {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/4909a5675669096655533e412a7ec8643a2ebd83.png

We are trying to approach the city optimally to simultaneously reflect the real medieval cities and create a playground for your bandit.

notes.title: Bandit Simulator - Devlog #3
notes.content:
Hello, bandits!

In this short dev-blog, we will tell you about the creation of some world elements in our game.

                                                                                                                                    

One of the most important elements of the bandit world is the abandoned the fort in the mountain. Which almost nobody wants to talk about, it is only certain that, as a result of strange events people fled this place as quickly as possible, destroying the only path behind them.


The photos below show the process of creating the terrain and the first environmental obstacles, and be warned, this is just the beginning of the challenges we will pose for you.


          {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/be7d6e6afd843b87084b934324e443f64c1568e6.png

          {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/4c679d6f4f8b173874eaef0588603bcd5c1d603e.png

          {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/12e9e20cd35376149e3987dfe1e04c66686f976c.png


Therefore, if you want to get there with your bandit, a riddle and a struggle with adversities await you.

notes.title: Bandit Simulator - Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello, bandits!

Today we want to tell you about the locks, houses and taverns you will be able to visit in our game. 

                                                                                                                                    

There will be many types of buildings and chests in the game with different contents. Of course, to "visit" the house while the owner is away, you will have to deal with locks, which will become more and more difficult to open after each “visit”. 


The same goes for opening chests. In order to get the loot, you will have to face a lock.


          {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/a1dd367d267e2ba13edefb6a0110f853016a7616.gif


And when it comes to taverns, it will be fun. Not only that you can talk to the innkeeper there, you can bet a penny in tavern games, and even get into a fight. 


          {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/68f6e93ac93de2164f4625b2481214ac51052bbc.png


What do you think, what are the strangest items you can find deeply hidden in a medieval mansion?
And remember, hit add to wishlist button, to be up to date.

                                                                                                                                    

Best regards
Bandit Simulator team

notes.title: Bandit Simulator - Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hello, bandits!

We are starting with a series of devlogs about work in the game. We will inform you about the progress we make and the features we add.

                                                                                                                                    

First, a little bit about the hero. We start the game as a beginner bandit who, as a result of unpleasant accidents, ended up in the wrong place and at the wrong time, which ended up in prison in a city he did not know. We want the area to be diverse and interesting.


           {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/66c100b756029556384437ede080518cb470b925.png


 Will he manage to escape? 
 Will he manage to meet new companions? 
 Will it stand in the way of vice?

This and much more will depend only on your style of play.


           {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/b03bfab6797d7c1bb703247fc4cc0eef3ae602a2.png


What do you think, would be the ideal "career" path of a bandit?
